name: GRAMMER Offroad Intelligence Ontology V1
purpose: Defines the enterprise intelligence object model and relationship standards for the GRAMMER Offroad Intelligence Hub.
strategicPrinciple: One intelligence object should feed multiple pages and views without duplicate manual recreation.

businessEntities.description: OEMs, accounts or customer groups relevant for Offroad intelligence.
Competing companies, products or supplier alternatives.
Technology themes, capabilities or solution areas relevant for GRAMMER.
Offroad applications such as excavator, tractor, forklift or turf equipment.
Market segments such as Agriculture, Construction, Material Handling and Turf.
Countries, regions or market geographies relevant for intelligence interpretation.
Strategic themes that connect evidence, signals, assessments, risks, opportunities and actions.
GRAMMER product families, modules or product concepts.

intelligenceObjects.description: Raw or curated source-backed observation from news, patents, financials, releases, trade media or internal information.
A meaningful change, emerging pattern or weak signal derived from one or more evidence items.

intelligenceObjects.questionAnswered: What does it mean for GRAMMER?
intelligenceObjects.description: Analyst or AI-supported interpretation of signals with business implication, confidence and time horizon.
Commercial, product, innovation or strategic upside linked to evidence and assessments.
Commercial, competitive, supply, technology or strategic downside linked to evidence and assessments.

intelligenceObjects.questionAnswered: What should a GRAMMER function do?
intelligenceObjects.description: Recommended next step for Sales, R&D, Innovation, Product Management, Procurement, Strategy or Management.

confidenceModel.principle: Recommendations should not jump directly from news to action. Evidence, signal, assessment and confidence should be preserved.

governanceRules: Do not duplicate the same intelligence manually across multiple pages.
Use identifiers to link intelligence objects across files.
Every recommendation should preserve the chain back to evidence where possible.
Theme IDs should be used as the main connection layer across pages.
The UI should consume linked intelligence objects rather than creating separate page-specific logic.
